description: JST SM04B-SRSS-TB — 4-pin SH-series wire-to-board connector, 1.0mm pitch, side-entry SMD. Used in Qwiic/Stemma QT ecosystem. Mates with JST SHR-04V-S-B crimp housing.
name: jst-sh-4p-qwiic
watch_out_for: 1.0mm pitch — fine-pitch soldering. Mates with JST SH 1.0mm plugs. Qwiic/Stemma standard pinout: 1=GND(black), 2=VCC(red), 3=SDA(blue), 4=SCL(yellow). Not keyed — verify orientation.
